criteria.name: Use of underlying technology
criteria.verdict: Gemma does real work here, and the Sentry spans prove it rather than decorate it.
criteria.evidence_quote: every model call is a gen_ai.chat span, so you can see the 3 retries that saved the demo

criteria.name: Usability and user experience
criteria.verdict: One command and a live link; a judge can try it in under a minute.
criteria.evidence_quote: Try it live: no sign-up, paste any GitHub issue URL

criteria.name: Originality and creativity
criteria.verdict: Triage bots exist; the measured before/after is what makes it yours.
criteria.evidence_quote: Our median time-to-label dropped from 22 minutes to 13

criteria.name: Writing and presentation
criteria.verdict: A number in the title, a GIF in the first screen, and a test anyone can repeat.
criteria.evidence_quote: Here is the exact test so you can run it on your own repo

why_not_winning: It nearly does. The winners also opened with a personal problem; yours opens with architecture.
Two of three winners showed failure honestly. You hide the 9% of issues the agent mislabels.
The ElevenLabs category is claimed in passing, but the voice feature is a footnote.
top_fixes: Open with the Tuesday your team drowned in 140 untriaged issues, then show the 41%.
Add a short 'Where it fails' section with the 9% mislabels and what you'd do next.
Either cut the ElevenLabs claim or give the voice summary its own GIF and a sentence on why it helps.
better_title: 140 Untriaged Issues on a Tuesday: How an Open-Source Agent Cut Our Triage Time by 41%
better_opening: Last Tuesday our repo had 140 untriaged issues and nobody wanted Monday's job. So I built an agent on an open-weight model that labels, deduplicates and summarises them. Our median time-to-label fell from 22 minutes to 13. Here is the build, the test, and the 9% it still gets wrong.
count_says: Mortal, I came prepared to object and find myself merely... advising. Fix the opening and this jury may remember your name.
voice_line: Mortal, I came prepared to object and find myself merely... advising. Fix the opening and this jury may remember your name. Overall: 84 out of one hundred.
